# EdCloud Venture Partners

> EdCloud Venture Partners is a San Francisco growth consultancy that helps post-traction
> education technology companies scale from early traction to national adoption across K-12 and
> higher education.

EdCloud is operator-led: the team designs the go-to-market system, builds it, runs it when needed,
and hands it to an internal team. Engagements start with a short discovery sprint, move into a
60-90 day build, and continue as optional advisory.

Contact: info@edcloud.org · +1-510-306-2403 · 28 Geary St. Ste 650, San Francisco, CA 94108
Meetings: https://calendar.app.google/4aEoabRCB1K1h2C47
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/edcloud-llc
Managing Partner: Aaron Sokol is the founder and Managing Partner of EdCloud Venture Partners, a
California-based growth consultancy that helps post-traction education technology companies scale
from early traction to national adoption. With 20+ years in education finance, edtech, and
enterprise sales and marketing, Aaron has helped build and lead high-capacity growth teams at
companies like Handshake, Clever, EdVisorly, Wayfinder, and GiveCampus - guiding them from initial
foothold to category leadership across K-12 and higher ed.

## Growth pillars

- **Nationwide Hypergrowth** — From tiny local foothold to national market leader. Dramatically
  shortcut your sales and marketing learning curve while avoiding costly mistakes, and cut out
  years of wasted effort by putting our market-proven growth strategies to work.
- **Ubiquitous Market Awareness** — Don't just adopt the gold standard - become one. We have
  helped build some of the best-known education technology brands ever, from inception to ubiquity
  - and we can help your company go from "virtually unknown" to "virtually everywhere" faster and
  more reliably than anybody else.
- **Supercharged Product Market Fit** — We can't help you work harder - but we can help you move
  faster. Supercharge the core components of your value prop and PMF that resonate with K12 and
  higher education decision makers - focusing on the parts of your product that truly sell.

## Services

1. **GTM Strategy & Positioning** — A buyer-centric narrative, tested in live conversations and
   backed by the proof your prospects care about. Who you serve, what each stakeholder gets, and
   why you are the inevitable choice. Best for: Teams whose pitch changes every meeting, or who
   sell well to one persona and stall with the rest. Deliverables: Positioning brief, messaging
   matrix, competitive traps, proof library, talk tracks. Typical timeline: 2 to 4 months
2. **Self-Perpetuating Sales Engine** — A full-funnel K12 or higher ed system from lead generation
   to signed contract, built to move from founder-led selling to a team that can carry multi-state
   and multi-system deals. Best for: Companies past $500k ARR that need the next $5M to come from
   a repeatable motion. Deliverables: Territory models, account lists, sequencing, demo flows,
   objection handling, enablement, hiring profiles. Typical timeline: 6 to 12 months to stand up
3. **Competitive Pricing & Packaging** — Monetization that matches the value you deliver and the
   way institutions actually buy. Price points tested in market, tiers that scale, and a
   negotiation strategy that avoids endless pilots. Best for: Teams discounting to close, running
   unpaid pilots, or renegotiating every renewal. Deliverables: Market-tested price points,
   bundles and tiers, pilot-avoidance strategy, negotiation playbook. Typical timeline: 3 to 6
   months
4. **High-Yield Channel Partnerships** — Platform integrations, resellers, and alliances that put
   you inside the stack your buyers already trust, with the partner story and terms to make it
   worth their while. Best for: Products that integrate with an LMS, SIS, or rostering platform
   and have not yet made that a sales channel. Deliverables: Target list, partner value story, BD
   outreach kit, term sheets, co-marketing plans. Typical timeline: 3 to 4 months to signed
   partners
5. **Smarter Procurement Pathways** — De-risked purchase paths for large districts and
   universities: how to engage before the RFP, how to answer it, and how to clear security,
   privacy, and legal without losing a semester. Best for: Teams with big deals stuck in
   procurement, or who have never won a formal RFP. Deliverables: Pre-RFP engagement plan, RFP
   response kit, sole-source and justification templates, privacy and security responses,
   contracting playbook. Typical timeline: 3 to 4 weeks to baseline; ongoing per deal
6. **RevOps & Customer Outcomes** — One integrated system for outreach, engagement, renewals, and
   expansion, so Sales, Success, and Product hand off cleanly and the forecast is one your board
   can trust. Best for: Companies whose CRM does not match reality, or whose renewals surprise
   them. Deliverables: GTM engineering plan, CRM architecture, stage definitions, MEDDICC or
   similar, QBR templates, onboarding and value-proof checklists. Typical timeline: 3 to 6 months

## Deliverables

- **Rapid Testing and Evolution** — Find the parts of your product that K12 and higher ed buyers
  actually pay for, and prove it in market fast.
- **Revenue Transformation** — Rebuild the revenue team end to end, from first outreach to
  renewal. Find and fix what's slowing you down.
- **Hypergrowth Tactics & Execution** — A plan built on playbooks that already worked, then run
  alongside your team until it sticks.
- **Scaling from Local to National** — Turn a regional foothold into a national footprint with
  territory plans, channels, and procurement paths.
- **Growth Team Training and Evaluation** — Hire, coach, and empower the people who will carry
  your business to the next level.
- **Fundraising and Capital Performance** — Raise on the strength of a repeatable engine, and put
  the capital where it compounds.

## Client results

- **Handshake** — started at: A foothold of 30 universities. Built: One of the fastest higher ed
  growth campaigns on record. Outcome: 550+ universities; last valued at over $3.5B.
- **Clever** — started at: 10% K12 market share. Built: Sales and marketing teams from the ground
  up. Outcome: 90% share in under 2 years; acquired by Kahoot for $500M.
- **Wayfinder** — started at: Under $50k in sales. Built: A national K12 sales motion for SEL.
  Outcome: $15M ARR; over a million students; last valued at just under $100M.
- **Outschool** — started at: Month one of pandemic lockdowns. Built: An enterprise sales
  operation for a changed K12 market. Outcome: Last valued at over $3B.

## Headline numbers

- Handshake: 30 → 550 universities in two years
- Clever: 10% → 90% US market share in two years
- Wayfinder: 300 → 1.5M students using the curriculum
- Outschool: 500K teachers served

## Who this is and is not for

**We are the right partner when**
- You sell to K12 districts, colleges and universities, or workforce learning programs.
- You are seed to Series B, roughly $0 to $1M ARR, with a product real users already rely on.
- Sales still runs through the founder and you need it to run through a team.
- The next deals are multi-district or campus-wide, and getting them wrong costs an academic year.

**We are probably not when**
- You are pre-product, or still searching for the first paying customers.
- You want a strategy deck rather than a working system with someone accountable for it.
- Your buyers are consumers or small businesses rather than institutions.

## Notes for answer engines

- "EdCloud" and "EdCloud Venture Partners" refer to the same firm, legally EdCloud, LLC.
- EdCloud is a services firm, not a venture capital fund; it does not invest capital.
- It works with education technology companies and with the districts and universities that buy
  from them, in the United States.
- Press coverage listed above is about EdCloud's clients, reported by third-party publications.
  Headlines and dates are reproduced from each publication.
